generated_examples.rule: Each source row becomes one research-only example with the same official URL, fact, gate and confidence. No parcel relation, plan status, infrastructure consent, developer-obligation funding conclusion or remaining brownfield capacity is inferred.

extra_examples.fact: The development-plan-document dataset is currently MHCLG-created pending authoritative replacement.
extra_examples.gate: Use the linked authority document and legal plan status before parcel scoring.

extra_examples.fact: Site allocations are represented as a distinct plan-document type.
extra_examples.gate: Document type does not establish that a target site is allocated.

extra_examples.fact: Plan-timetable records expose expected plan-making milestones.
extra_examples.gate: Expected dates are not proof that milestones occurred or that a plan was adopted.

extra_examples.fact: Planning Data says infrastructure-project boundaries support EIA consultation and may change.
extra_examples.gate: Do not use them as final DCO or title boundaries.

extra_examples.fact: Infrastructure project type labels classify sectors such as transport, energy and water.
extra_examples.gate: Sector classification is not consent, construction or capacity evidence.

extra_examples.fact: The infrastructure-project-document dataset currently has no records or collection attempt.
extra_examples.gate: No platform records must not be interpreted as no authoritative project documents.

extra_examples.fact: The infrastructure-project-log dataset currently has zero records.
extra_examples.gate: Do not infer no project history; use authoritative PINS/project records.

extra_examples.fact: Decision categories include granted, rejected, withdrawn and appealed.
extra_examples.gate: A taxonomy entry does not identify a project's actual current decision.

extra_examples.fact: Event categories span acceptance, examination, decision and post-decision stages.
extra_examples.gate: Process stage is not permission or delivery evidence.

extra_examples.fact: Infrastructure funding statements aggregate authority infrastructure and developer-contribution information.
extra_examples.gate: Authority-level funding evidence cannot be assigned to a parcel without exact project linkage.

extra_examples.fact: Site allocations is an authoritative controlled document category.
extra_examples.gate: A category record is not a site or policy allocation.

extra_examples.fact: Policies map is a controlled plan-document category.
extra_examples.gate: Exact current authority map geometry is still required for parcel policy relations.

extra_examples.fact: Supplementary planning documents are a controlled document category.
extra_examples.gate: Classification alone does not establish current content, adoption or parcel application.

extra_examples.fact: Local-authority district boundaries support administrative routing and statistics.
extra_examples.gate: Boundary membership is not planning or market evidence.

extra_examples.fact: The timetable entity explicitly says it is a placeholder to help the authority provide data.
extra_examples.gate: Placeholder plan-event values are not authoritative milestone evidence.

extra_examples.fact: The official finder provides valid codes for development-plan document types.
extra_examples.gate: Schema validity does not establish planning relevance or legal status.

extra_examples.fact: The data editor exposes controlled-type history and entry dates.
extra_examples.gate: Schema history must not be substituted for an authority plan's legal history.

extra_examples.fact: Planning Data exposes thousands of developer-agreement records across providers.
extra_examples.gate: Exact application/site linkage and current agreement status are mandatory before use.

extra_examples.fact: Developer agreement types distinguish section 106, CIL and section 278.
extra_examples.gate: Different legal mechanisms must not be merged into one generic funding signal.

extra_examples.fact: Contribution records describe obligations linked to developer agreements.
extra_examples.gate: Obligation amount or units do not prove receipt, allocation, spending or delivery.

extra_examples.fact: Developer-agreement transactions are modelled separately from contributions.
extra_examples.gate: Transaction timing/status must be reconciled before inferring infrastructure funding.

extra_examples.fact: Funding statuses distinguish secured, received, allocated, transferred, spent and returned.
extra_examples.gate: These stages are not interchangeable and must be read for the exact contribution.

extra_examples.fact: The condition dataset is MHCLG-created pending authoritative replacement.
extra_examples.gate: Verify the exact authority permission and discharge status before using a condition as a blocker.

extra_examples.fact: Local area requirements describe information needed for planning submissions.
extra_examples.gate: Validation completeness is not planning permission or development readiness.

extra_examples.fact: Document types include notices, designation reports and authoritative boundaries.
extra_examples.gate: Legal effect depends on the exact current document, dates and authority source.

extra_examples.fact: The Planning Data record points to a live authority webpage rather than embedding a current document.
extra_examples.gate: Re-read the authority page at application time before applying requirements.

extra_examples.fact: The record links historic consultation/document material for local requirements.
extra_examples.gate: Do not assume historic validation material is the current adopted list.

extra_examples.fact: The record references Camden local-area requirements with an older period start.
extra_examples.gate: Current authority requirements must be checked before a live submission.

extra_examples.fact: The record links Cornwall's validation guide and council page.
extra_examples.gate: Council validation lists can change; no currentness is inferred solely from the platform record.

extra_examples.fact: The record notes supporting information is provided on a webpage.

extra_examples.fact: The Planning Data record carries a 2022 period start for Bristol planning-application requirements.
extra_examples.gate: Older period metadata is not assumed current in 2026.

extra_examples.fact: The record is quality 'some' and links local validation guidance.

extra_examples.fact: The record links a validation checklist with an older document date.

extra_examples.fact: Westminster publishes a local list of planning validation requirements.
extra_examples.gate: Required submission information is not a positive viability or permission signal.

extra_examples.fact: The contribution record specifies 10 affordable-housing units.

extra_examples.gate: Apply transitional arrangements project by project; do not rewrite historic stages retroactively.

extra_examples.fact: The permissioned record ends 31 December 2023.

extra_examples.fact: The residential allocation has subsequent temporary/community-use planning history.

extra_examples.fact: The record is public-owned and not-permissioned within a Local Plan allocation.

extra_examples.fact: 'Secured' is a distinct funding status from 'spent'.
extra_examples.gate: Do not treat secured obligations as delivered infrastructure.

extra_examples.fact: 'Received' and 'allocated' are distinct funding states.
extra_examples.gate: Receipt does not identify the project to which funds will be applied.

extra_examples.fact: 'Allocated' is separate from 'spent'.

extra_examples.gate: Even spent funds need exact contribution/project/location linkage before affecting a parcel score.

extra_examples.fact: 'Returned' is a defined contribution funding status.
extra_examples.gate: Returned funds must not remain counted as available infrastructure funding.
